yearReview.title: Year in review
yearReview.pinHint: Selecting highlights this category in every chart
yearReview.m01: Where {y} has no data, the nearest available year is shown
yearReview.f6one: {name} was the only tax that fell
yearReview.f2h: For every 100 GEL of VAT collected, {n} GEL was given up in tax breaks
yearReview.f1top: Debt service was the largest spending item
yearReview.f1h: Debt service was the {r} largest spending item
yearReview.f3onlyDown: the only one of {n} spending types that fell
yearReview.f3onlyUp: the only one of {n} spending types that grew
yearReview.f4h: Debt repayments and interest came to {p} of tax revenue
yearReview.f5h: {p} of municipal spending is in just {k} of the {count} municipalities
yearReview.iceK: ↑ collected · ↓ given up in tax breaks · {y}
yearReview.iceK0: ↑ collected · ↓ given up in tax breaks
yearReview.iceItem: {name}: {a} collected, {b} given up ({r} GEL per 100 GEL)
yearReview.rfRec: the highest since records began in {from}
yearReview.tbNote: Each tax break amount is a Ministry of Finance estimate of the revenue the break cost the budget. The latest report covers {to}.
yearReview.negNote: a negative amount is left out of the split
yearReview.s2Gen: What changed since the previous year
yearReview.s2None: {y} is the first year in the data, so there is nothing to compare with.
yearReview.newCat: {name} has no data for {y}, so no change is shown.
yearReview.tmNote: General government is wider than the state budget (it also covers municipalities), so this total differs from the one above.
yearReview.dfAria: General government balance, % of GDP, {from}–{to}. {y}: {v}. Largest deficit: {my}, {mv}.
yearReview.wallNote: {projFrom}–{to} shows only the repayment schedule for debt already taken on; new borrowing is not included.
yearReview.ledNote: Each line comes from a different dataset, so they cannot be added up.
yearReview.led.spend.name: State budget spending
yearReview.led.tax.name: Tax revenue
yearReview.led.debt.name: Government debt
yearReview.led.svc.name: Debt repayments and interest
yearReview.led.soc.name: Social benefits
yearReview.led.mun.name: Municipal spending
yearReview.rgM: solid tick: regional average · dashed: median
yearReview.mpNote: Municipal figures exclude the Adjara Autonomous Republic budget.
yearReview.nSrc: Source: Ministry of Finance of Georgia and Geostat, as published on Fiscal.ge’s data pages. Last updated on Fiscal.ge: {date}.
yearReview.nScope: Three different scopes: spending by field and institution covers the state budget; receipts cover the consolidated budget; spending types and the balance cover general government. Figures from different scopes do not add up.
yearReview.nBasisExp: State budget: {from}–{to} actual execution for the full 12 months; {planYear} is the approved plan, and its change compares the plan with {to} actuals.
yearReview.nBasisExpActual: State budget: {from}–{to} actual execution for the full 12 months.
yearReview.nRev: Receipts: {from}–{to} actuals. The {from} increase in liabilities is unavailable. “Other taxes” were negative in {negFrom}–{negTo} and count as zero in the splits.
yearReview.nRevBase: Receipts: {from}–{to} actuals. The {from} increase in liabilities is unavailable.
yearReview.nTB: Tax breaks: {tbFrom}–{tbTo}, Ministry of Finance estimates. Tax refunds: {rfFrom}–{rfTo}, Treasury.
yearReview.nDebt: Debt: Ministry of Finance debt bulletins and strategy. Stock at the end of {from}–{to}; repayments for {projFrom}–{projTo} cover only existing debt.
yearReview.nMun: Municipalities: {year} actuals; per-resident figures are Fiscal.ge’s.
yearReview.nPop: Per resident: Geostat population on 1 January ({y}: {v}).
yearReview.nPopBreak: Per resident: Geostat population on 1 January ({y}: {v}). On 1 January {b} Geostat re-based the population to the census, so per-resident figures before and after that date are on different bases and are not compared.
yearReview.nGdp: GDP: Geostat, at current prices; {prelim} GDP is preliminary. GDP follows SNA 1993 up to 2009 and SNA 2008 from 2010.
yearReview.nRound: Every 100 GEL: exactly 100 cells in whole GEL, rounded so that they always add up to 100.
yearReview.nNominal: All amounts are in current prices, not adjusted for inflation.
yearReview.metaDescription: Georgia’s public finances in one year: receipts, tax breaks, spending, deficit, debt and municipalities on one page, with a year to choose.
